headline: Sensex Ends Volatile Session Flat, Nifty Holds 25,300 as Financials and Realty Lead

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty traded flat in a volatile session, holding around the 25,300 level.
Financial and realty stocks outperformed, driving market support along with smallcap indices.
Retail inflation crossed RBI's upper target limit for the first time in two years, reaching 6.1% in October 2026.
Mixed Q2 corporate earnings results led to stock-specific action across sectors.
whatHappening: Nifty 50 closed near 25,300 led by top gainers HDFC Life and Bajaj Finance.
Oil India reported a 53% rise in Q2 net profit to ₹2,521 crore on higher realization.
Ola Electric narrowed its Q2 net loss to ₹362 crore despite a 39% plunge in revenue.
Roto Pumps gained 14% while realty stocks surged up to 4% during the trading session.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed flat following a volatile session, holding the 25,300 level supported by financial and realty stocks. India's retail inflation rose to 6.1% in October 2026, crossing the RBI's upper tolerance threshold for the first time in two years. Stock-specific movements were driven by quarterly earnings results, notably from Oil India and Ola Electric.
